author: Sandra K.
quote: My mother came home from the hospital after hip surgery and couldn't manage the two steps at our front door. Ontario Ramp Solutions had a ramp delivered and installed the next morning. It made a world of difference — she could come and go on her own terms.

author: Bridal Barn Event Venue
quote: We had a bride's grandmother who uses a power wheelchair attending the wedding. The team showed up the morning of, set up a ramp at the main entrance and a platform at the ceremony area, and everything was perfect. Professional, fast, and completely reliable.

author: Jim A.
quote: We manage 12 residential rental properties. Ontario Ramp Solutions helped us bring three of them into AODA compliance with permanent aluminum ramps. Fair pricing, clean installs, and they handled all the permit paperwork. I'll use them for every future property.
